note: Indicators on watch: the measurable dials this narrative argues through. Extracted from the corpus transcripts (every threshold is attributed to the speaker who named it in a video; nothing here is a Narrative Radar forecast).
method: transcript extraction (18 transcripts) + editorial synthesis; thresholds quote what predictors said, not what is true

indicators.name: Bitcoin four-year cycle clock
indicators.punchline: The whole fight runs on one clock: every prior bear bottomed 12 months after the peak, which lands this one in October 2026 — unless the cycle is dead.

thresholds.level: Bottom exactly 12 months after the bull peak (~late October 2026)
thresholds.meaning: History says the low is roughly three months away

thresholds.level: 53 weekly bars from the cycle high; currently week 42
thresholds.meaning: 10-12 more weeks of downside risk into October

thresholds.level: Bottom October-November 2026, 'Valhalla' January-February 2027
thresholds.meaning: Bear markets take about one year to flush psychology

thresholds.level: Projected October 2026 low may not happen
thresholds.meaning: Two anomalies (pre-halving ATH, minimum-extension top) suggest the cycle is dead and the low is forming now

thresholds.level: Mid-bull-run in 2028
thresholds.meaning: Cycle intact; do not capitulate, upside arrives next year

indicators.contested_note: Bulls treat the 12-month rhythm as a literal schedule for an October bottom; FibSwanny reads this cycle's two anomalies as proof the four-year clock itself has stopped ticking, and Hougan/Le argue institutional money is dampening it into irrelevance.

indicators.name: Bitcoin bear floor ($57.5K and the zones below)
indicators.punchline: Nearly every chart in the corpus ends at the same tripwire: the whole watch comes down to whether Bitcoin holds $57.5K.

thresholds.level: $57,778 — 61.8% retracement of the full low-to-high
thresholds.meaning: Heavy buying interest; the main reason the 57-58K low is called 'in'

thresholds.level: $63,000 ascending trendline
thresholds.meaning: A break re-attacks the $57.8K lows; below $57K the bullish setup is cancelled entirely

thresholds.level: Third monthly close under $64,618
thresholds.meaning: Confirms macro breakdown

thresholds.level: $53K-$60K zone (127-141% fib, 89-month EMA ~$53K)
thresholds.meaning: 'Back the truck up' accumulation zone matching the last two cycle bottoms
Would not surprise; still a reasonable bear-market floor, no deep flush expected

thresholds.level: At or below the 200-week moving average
thresholds.meaning: Historically extremely cheap; buy zone runs down into the 40s

thresholds.level: $40K on a break of $49K
thresholds.meaning: Threshold-theory downside target through an air pocket of no support

thresholds.level: $35K by ~October
thresholds.meaning: Head-and-shoulders measured move; he only starts nibbling below $50K

indicators.contested_note: The same $50-60K band is FibSwanny's and Ivan's back-the-truck-up buy zone and Soloway's trapdoor to $35K — identical levels, opposite trades.

indicators.name: Clarity Act passage (US crypto legislation)
indicators.punchline: A 30-40% coin flip in Congress that Hougan calls the shotgun start of the next bull market — decided by August recess.

thresholds.level: Polymarket ~40% odds, Aug 7 deadline
thresholds.meaning: A toss-up; passage is the immediate shotgun start of a new bull market, failure brings volatility but not the end

thresholds.level: ~30% odds before August recess
thresholds.meaning: The trigger to watch; regulators would issue rules anyway

thresholds.level: Bank-adoption index 32 to 50 in 6-12 months if it passes; 32 to 40 if it fails
thresholds.meaning: Banks dive in with law behind them, tiptoe without it

indicators.contested_note: Hougan calls passage the bull-market starting gun; Le, Saylor and Armstrong shrug that the same rules arrive via SEC and executive action anyway, so long term the vote doesn't matter.

indicators.name: Institutional adoption flows (ETFs, wirehouses, pensions)
indicators.punchline: The bull case in one stat: institutions now hold 38% of spot Bitcoin ETF assets, up from 24%, and BlackRock says every portfolio needs 1-2%.

thresholds.level: 38% institutional share of spot ETF assets, up from 24% a year earlier; $100B+ combined AUM
thresholds.meaning: Institutions accelerating allocation mid-downturn, treating the dip as entry

thresholds.level: BlackRock: 1-2% Bitcoin allocation for multi-asset portfolios (June 2026)
thresholds.meaning: Zero exposure becomes the risky outlier position

thresholds.level: ~1.27M BTC (over 6% of max supply) held by spot ETFs
thresholds.meaning: Institutional demand is no longer an expectation but already happening

thresholds.level: A couple percent of $30 trillion of institutional wealth
thresholds.meaning: Forced inflows over the next couple of years once crypto is the default capital stack

thresholds.level: Morgan Stanley: 16,000 advisers, ~$7T AUM, 0.14%-fee crypto ETPs
thresholds.meaning: Wirehouse distribution floodgates open

thresholds.level: 80% of Strategy's buyers were retail
thresholds.meaning: The institutional wave everyone priced in never actually arrived last cycle

indicators.contested_note: Bulls read institutional ownership as the permanent floor and next marginal buyer; Klippsten calls ETF holders 'paper hands' who are easy to shake out, so the same flows are fragile fuel, not bedrock.

indicators.name: Strategy (MSTR) balance-sheet stress
indicators.punchline: The bears' doomsday machine: Strategy sits $12K underwater on 840,000 Bitcoin, and everyone watches whether STRC at $94.50 forces it to sell.

thresholds.level: Average cost $75,000 per BTC vs ~$63,000 spot
thresholds.meaning: CNBC's forced-seller case; Le rejects it — average cost is not important and they are not forced sellers

thresholds.level: STRC back to $100 par (currently ~$94.50, IPO'd at 90)
thresholds.meaning: Par restarts the issuance flywheel that funds Bitcoin accumulation

thresholds.level: 2-3 years of STRC dividend coverage (now 2.3 years, ~$4B reserve)
thresholds.meaning: The level needed for Stretch investors to trust the dividend and restart inflows

thresholds.level: 1x mNAV
thresholds.meaning: Capital-allocation trigger: below 1x, selling BTC to buy back MSTR is accretive per share

thresholds.level: 5% net leverage; 2028 convert wall cut from $5B to $3.5B
thresholds.meaning: The over-leverage criticism is dead; sales were 1/35th of purchases

indicators.contested_note: Bears see a leveraged whale one spiral away from a forced-selling cascade; Strategy answers with 5% net leverage, 35x more Bitcoin bought than sold, and bulls note the market shrugged when Saylor actually did sell.

indicators.name: Drawdown depth vs prior winters
indicators.punchline: This bear stopped at -50% where the last ones went -75% and -85% — Wall Street's proof Bitcoin is maturing and the worst is already behind us.

thresholds.level: -50% this cycle vs -75% last drawdown
thresholds.meaning: 'Exactly on trend' maturation; Wall Street reads the dip as an entry point

thresholds.level: Prior bears -85% and -77%; anything under -70% acceptable
thresholds.meaning: A shallower bear consistent with the muted bull that preceded it

thresholds.level: Past winters' -75% cascades were 100-to-1 leverage backed by air
thresholds.meaning: The man-made structure that caused deep winters has been wiped out and can't be rebuilt

indicators.contested_note: Bulls read the shallow -50% as structural maturity; the on-chain bear camp reads the same number as a flush that simply hasn't finished.

indicators.name: Bull-market reclaim levels ($67K-$95K)
indicators.punchline: Nobody declares the bull back until Bitcoin reclaims a number — $67K, $73K, $81K, or $95K, depending on whose chart you trust.

thresholds.level: Break above $67,000
thresholds.meaning: Odds jump to 75-80% of a quick run to $71-72K

thresholds.level: Punch through $73,000
thresholds.meaning: Not back in a bull until then; above it, little resistance toward $200K

thresholds.level: Bull flip at $81K; weekly closes above ~$82K
thresholds.meaning: High likelihood the bull market is back with a run toward $200K

thresholds.level: Reclaim ~$95K
thresholds.meaning: Monthly chart re-enters the bull zone and turns genuinely bullish

indicators.name: Global liquidity / end of QT
indicators.punchline: The macro camp's thesis in a date: QT ended December 1, 2025, and every crypto bull market in history started when the liquidity spigot reopened.

thresholds.level: QT ended December 1, 2025
thresholds.meaning: Post-QT normalization mirrors the exact setup that preceded the 2020 ETH/BTC bottom and bull run

thresholds.level: Fed pivot on weakening data
thresholds.meaning: Rotates liquidity from the cooling AI trade back into Bitcoin

indicators.contested_note: The liquidity camp says this replaces the four-year clock entirely — crypto moves with money printing and debasement, not halvings, which is why they ignore the October-bottom countdown.

indicators.name: Seller exhaustion (bad news no longer dumps price)
indicators.punchline: Hacks, Saylor selling, BitMEX closing — Bitcoin holds $64K through all of it, while long-term holder supply sits at all-time highs. Nobody left to sell.

thresholds.level: All-time highs in coins unmoved 6 and 12+ months
thresholds.meaning: Strong hands own the float; a floor is being put in at current levels

thresholds.level: BitMEX closure, treasury-company capitulation
thresholds.meaning: The kind of events that historically mark the bottom

thresholds.level: $64K holds through hacks, Saylor sales, STRC at 75
thresholds.meaning: Sellers are exhausted; the bear cycle is ending

indicators.name: Stablecoin AUM and flows
indicators.punchline: One number, two religions: stablecoin assets are growing through the bear — but no new money has actually flowed in since October.

thresholds.level: No inflows since October; recent outflows
thresholds.meaning: No new capital in crypto — expect another sell-off of maybe 30% before any recovery

thresholds.level: Stablecoin AUM up significantly despite the bear market
thresholds.meaning: Proof the onchain-TradFi convergence that ends the winter is already happening

thresholds.level: Base: ~$32T stablecoin transfer volume in 12 months; over 90% of agentic volume
thresholds.meaning: Rails adoption compounding regardless of price

indicators.contested_note: Hougan reads rising stablecoin AUM as bull-thesis proof; Gerhard reads the flat-to-outflowing market cap as zero fresh capital and calls for another 30% down — the same gauge powering both camps' strongest slide.

indicators.name: ISM PMI 55 line
indicators.punchline: Every altcoin supercycle started when PMI crossed 55 — August printed 55.6, the first cross in four years, and the September 1 print is the falsifier.

thresholds.level: Cross above 55 with momentum (55.6 on Aug 3, up 2.3 in a month)
thresholds.meaning: Every prior cross (Feb 2017, Sep 2020) started the most powerful altcoin moves in crypto history

thresholds.level: September 1 print back under 55
thresholds.meaning: The zone closes; the test failed

thresholds.level: PMI expands and altcoins still fail to rally
thresholds.meaning: Altcoins are done — this is their last chance

indicators.name: Altcoin reversal setups (ETH/BTC and market-cap MAs)
indicators.punchline: ETH/BTC is testing the same 20-month moving average that launched the 2020 run, and the altcoin market cap's 20-week just touched the 200-week — the exact signature of the last two bottoms.

thresholds.level: ETH/BTC monthly close above the 20-month MA
thresholds.meaning: Macro Ethereum reversal — prior wick attempts failed in October, January and April

thresholds.level: ETH: $1,500 downside trendline vs 200-day MA near $2,000
thresholds.meaning: $300 capitulation risk on one side, bullish cycle confirmation on the other

thresholds.level: Altcoin market cap 20-week MA touching the 200-week MA
thresholds.meaning: Marked the January 2023 and March 2019 bottoms

thresholds.level: 2-week MACD crossing above its signal line
thresholds.meaning: Marked prior macro altcoin bottoms

indicators.name: On-chain bottom gauges (CBBI, Puell, NUPL)
indicators.punchline: The bear's dashboard says not yet: CBBI at 32 versus a buy zone of 20 or lower, Puell at 0.65 versus 0.5, and NUPL still hasn't gone negative.

thresholds.level: CBBI at 32 (was 94 at the ~$120K peak); aggressive DCA only at 20, 10, or single digits
thresholds.meaning: The aggregate bottom signal has not fired

thresholds.level: Puell Multiple 0.65 vs green buy level at 0.5
thresholds.meaning: Miner-profitability flush incomplete; more downside likely

thresholds.level: NUPL must move into negative territory
thresholds.meaning: Bear markets only end when aggregate holders sit on unrealized losses — not there yet

indicators.contested_note: While the price-chart camp calls the $57.5K low in, this entire on-chain dashboard says the capitulation that ends bear markets hasn't happened yet.

indicators.name: Tokenization / TradFi convergence
indicators.punchline: Tokenized stocks growing 600% a year through a bear market — Hougan's proof the next bull doesn't need the four-year cycle, with $30B tokenized against $600T of world assets.

thresholds.level: Tokenized stocks growing ~600% a year during the bear
thresholds.meaning: The next bull market will be led by onchain-TradFi convergence projects

thresholds.level: $30B tokenized vs $600T of global assets — 'the market could 2000x'
thresholds.meaning: Roughly 1% penetration; size by market size, not market share

thresholds.level: $400-450T global finance addressable market
thresholds.meaning: DeFi and the on-chain rails are dramatically undersized against the real prize
